idea-plugin.name: Git AI Reviewer
idea-plugin.description:
Review uncommitted Git changes and generate commit messages using any OpenAI-compatible AI provider, with fully custom system prompts.

  • Review Uncommitted Changes (AI) — sends the uncommitted diff (staged + unstaged + untracked files) to your provider and shows a Markdown report in a tool window.
  • Generate Commit Message (AI) — drafts a Conventional Commits message from the staged changes and copies it to the clipboard, ready to paste in the commit dialog.
  • Configurable OpenAI-compatible providers (OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter, Groq, vLLM…), with a dedicated provider for review, commit, or a default one for everything.
  • Fully custom system prompts for review and commit messages, with a {language} placeholder.
  • API keys stored in the IDE password safe.
